answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the PR adds new enum values (IDENTITY_OF, WORKS_FOR, PERSON, ORGANIZATION, TEAM, etc.) to the graph DTOs, but the committed openaev-front api-types.d.ts was not regenerated. The job's own message says to run generate-types-from-api before committing. This is deterministic and will fail again on re-run until the types are regenerated and committed.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
